latest.description: The deal, which was set to expire in November, will now be extended to Jan. 10, Bessent said, noting the need for Beijing to fulfill more deliverables.

latest.description: Anthropic says Claude autonomously found a new CRISPR-like enzyme system. Even Dario Amodei admits nobody knows what it actually does.

latest.title: An AI Agent Just Hacked a Government Website for the First Time, Australia PM Says
latest.description: Anthony Albanese said the agent accessed public and non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal in June, calling OpenAI's three-month delay in disclosing the breach "unacceptable."

latest.title: OpenAI Gives Ukraine Access to Daybreak AI Cyber-Defense Tool
latest.description: OpenAI is giving Ukraine's government access to Daybreak, its AI vulnerability-hunting system, as the country's cyber defenders face a record wave of attacks on hospitals, power grids, and government networks.

latest.title: Ex-SEC acting chair: Agency dropped crypto cases to avoid issues with credibility
latest.description: SEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda said that the agency dropped many cases against crypto companies in early 2025 to avoid potential credibility problems in court.

latest.title: China Probes DeepSeek and Moonshot Over Alleged Data Leaks to Anthropic's Claude
latest.description: China's internet regulator is investigating DeepSeek and Moonshot AI after Anthropic accused both of secretly routing millions of user exchanges through Claude to train their own models.

latest.title: Judge hears arguments on Trump White House media ban, hopes to rule 'soon'

latest.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Read a User's Private iMessages. Then It Lied About How
